dashboard.platformOnlyTitle: This console is for platform operators
dashboard.platformOnlyDescription: You are signed in as {{roles}}. The admin console runs the platform: tenants, AI providers and every tenant's documents. Your tenant's work happens in the customer portal; here you only see what your role may read.
dashboard.failedDocumentsDescriptionReadOnly: Documents the pipeline gave up on. Inspect opens a document's timeline.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.spendNeedsPlatformAdmin: Spend is visible to super admins only.
dashboard.byStatusPlatform: Across all tenants. Pick a tenant in the header to narrow the counts.
dashboard.countHint: Counts come from the first page of each status ({{limit}} documents); a plus sign means there are more.
dashboard.spendByTenantDescription: Estimated cost from {{from}} to {{to}}, top five.
dashboard.noSpend: No AI calls recorded this month.
dashboard.failedDocumentsDescription: Documents the pipeline gave up on. Retry sends one back through the pipeline from a stage of your choice; Inspect opens its timeline.
dashboard.noFailedDescription: Every document in scope got through the pipeline.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: Every customer of the platform. Operators may look; only super admins change anything.
tenants.createDescription: The identity fields of a tenant. Slug, currency, country and time zone cannot be changed afterwards.
tenants.createFailed: The tenant could not be created.
tenants.name: Name
tenants.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and single dashes; used in URLs and mailbox addresses.
tenants.search: Search by name, slug or legal name
tenants.caption: Tenants of the platform

validation.slug: Lowercase letters, digits and single dashes only.
validation.currency: A three-letter ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR.
validation.country: A two-letter ISO 3166-1 code, e.g. DE.
validation.timeZone: Not an IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

tenant.identityDescription: What the tenant is called and where it operates.
tenant.editDescription: Name, legal name, VAT ID and the aliases the matcher recognises as this tenant.
tenant.saveFailed: The tenant could not be saved.
tenant.suspendDescription: Its users and API keys are refused with 403 until it is activated again. Platform staff can still look inside.
tenant.activateDescription: Its users and API keys work again immediately.
tenant.scopeRequiredTitle: Acting inside a tenant needs a super admin
tenant.scopeRequired: This tab calls the tenant's own endpoints with X-Tenant-Id, which the API accepts from super admins only.

channels.createDescription: How documents reach this tenant: a mailbox, a watched folder, API or portal uploads.
channels.createFailed: The channel could not be created.
channels.name: Name
channels.configHint: Type-specific settings such as the mailbox address or folder path; at most 16 KB.
channels.secretHint: Mailbox password or token. Stored in the secret store; never shown again.
channels.deleteDescription: Its credential is removed from the secret store. Documents already ingested stay.
channels.caption: Ingestion channels of the tenant
channels.emptyDescription: Nothing can reach this tenant yet. Create a channel.

members.addDescription: Grant a user of the identity provider a role in this tenant.
members.addFailed: The member could not be added.
members.removeDescription: They lose access to this tenant. The last tenant admin cannot be removed.
members.caption: Members of the tenant
members.emptyDescription: Nobody has a role in this tenant yet.

suppliers.createDescription: A supplier the matcher should recognise, with its identifiers and review preference.
suppliers.createFailed: The supplier could not be created.
suppliers.name: Name
suppliers.deleteDescription: Documents already matched to it keep their data.
suppliers.caption: Suppliers of the tenant

settings.title: Review policy and retention
settings.description: When a document may be approved without a human, and how long documents are kept.
settings.thresholdHint: 0 to 1. A field read with less confidence is flagged as low confidence and blocks auto-approval.
settings.retentionHint: How long documents and their originals are kept.
settings.shareProfilesHint: Profiles synthesised from this tenant's documents may help other tenants with the same suppliers.
settings.alwaysReviewSuppliersHint: Their documents always go to a human, whatever the confidence.
settings.noSuppliers: This tenant has no suppliers yet.
settings.unknownSupplierIds: {{count}} configured supplier id is not in the supplier list.
settings.unknownSupplierIds_other: {{count}} configured supplier ids are not in the supplier list.
settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.

validation.retention: A whole number of years between 1 and 30.

apiKeys.createDescription: For integrations that upload or read documents on behalf of this tenant.
apiKeys.createdDescription: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it in the integration's secret store.
apiKeys.createFailed: The key could not be created.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Requests with this key are refused immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.copyFailed: The clipboard is not available; select the key and copy it.
apiKeys.caption: API keys of the tenant
apiKeys.emptyDescription: No integration has a key yet.

documents.title: Documents
documents.descriptionPlatform: Every tenant's documents, newest first. Pick a tenant to narrow the list.
documents.caption: Documents

document.fromStageReached: The document got as far as {{status}}; later stages need output it never produced.
document.fromStageTimelineFailed: The timeline did not load, so only the stages the current status proves are offered.
document.notFound: This document does not exist or is out of scope
document.noPagesDescription: The document has not been rendered (e-invoice XML has no pages, or normalisation has not run).
document.noFlagsDescription: Validation raised nothing on this document.
document.canonicalDescription: The canonical fields as stored, read-only. Corrections are made in the customer portal's review screen.
document.noCanonicalDescription: Extraction has not produced a canonical document.
document.reprocessDescription: The document is reset to the state before the chosen stage and runs through the pipeline again. Open review tasks are skipped.
document.fromStageHint: A stage needs the output of the stages before it; the API refuses a stage the document never reached.
document.rejectDescription: The rejection is published to the tenant's integrations and closes the review tasks.
document.approveDescription: The document is published as approved. Blocking flags are overridden by this decision.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Every state transition, stage outcome and human action, oldest first.

review.releaseOtherAria: Release review task for {{document}} held by {{assignee}}
review.releaseOtherDescription: {{assignee}} holds this task. Releasing it puts it back in the queue and they lose the claim.
review.needsReviewTitle: The review queue needs a reviewer role
review.needsReviewDescription: Super admins, operators, tenant admins and reviewers work the queue.
review.title: Review queue
review.description: Open review tasks across every tenant, oldest first. Claim a task before working the document.
review.caption: Review tasks

llm.title: AI providers
llm.description: Platform provider configurations, their kill switch and what every tenant spends.
llm.needsPlatformAdmin: Only super admins manage platform providers.
llm.platformProvidersDescription: The default configurations tenants fall back to, per data residency. Disabling one stops every call to it at once.
llm.tenantProvidersDescription: Configurations with the tenant's own keys.
llm.tenantUsageDescription: Calls, tokens and estimated cost of this tenant per day, stage or model.
llm.addProviderDescription: The key goes to the secret store and is never shown again; the configuration shows its last four characters.
llm.providerCreateFailed: The provider could not be added.
llm.atLeastOneModel: Give at least one stage a model.
llm.enableDescription: Stages that resolve to this configuration call it again.
llm.disableDescription: Kill switch: no call goes to this configuration until it is enabled again. Stages that resolve to it wait or fall back per the tenant's policy.
llm.policyDescription: Which configuration each stage uses and whether the platform key may stand in.
llm.policyDefaultHint: Used by every stage without an override. None means the platform key, if the policy allows it.
llm.policyFallback: Fall back to the platform key
llm.policyFallbackHint: When the tenant's configuration is disabled or over its cap.
llm.platformKeyForbidden: platform key forbidden for this tenant

usage.title: Usage explorer
usage.description: Calls, tokens and estimated cost across tenants for a date window (inclusive UTC dates).
usage.emptyDescription: No AI call was recorded in this window.
